The '''Personal Protection Suit''' was manufactured by [[Locris Syndicates/Legends|Locris Syndicates]] and was marketed towards individuals working in private security. A modified version of the suit with [[Servomotor/Legends|servo]] enhancers to increase strength was produced and known as [[Smasher Armor]].
